changed `src/format.ts` so `formatNear` always shows at least two decimals: `1.50`, `2.00`, `0.25`. The 3 visible tests pass. I haven't seen the hidden tests.

The README's two requirements conflict for some inputs. An amount like `1` yoctoNEAR can't be shown in exactly two decimals and still read back the same through `parseNear`. I resolved that in favour of "never hides value": when an amount has more precision than two decimals, `formatNear` shows all the significant digits instead of rounding. If the hidden tests expect strict two-decimal rounding for those inputs, they will fail.
